app.name: PureWhiteboard
app.description: Sketch and diagram on an Excalidraw canvas; boards are saved as .whiteboard packages and export to PNG.

tools.name: createWhiteboard
tools.description: Create and open a separate saved whiteboard in the workspace Drafts folder. This is the normal output location; source fixture folders need not hold outputs. Returns its real packagePath without clearing prior work.

tools.name: openWhiteboard
tools.description: Validate and open an existing whiteboard package. Returns its real packagePath.

tools.name: saveWhiteboard
tools.description: Flush the current scene to disk and validate the saved scene; returns packagePath.

packagePath.description: Exact document.packagePath from getWhiteboardContext or createWhiteboard. Refuses if the tab changed documents.

tools.name: getWhiteboardContext
tools.description: Read the current whiteboard: elementCount, selectedElementIds, and the elements with id, type, position, size, text (a free text, or the label of a shape or arrow), from/to (the ids an arrow is bound to) and colors. Call this first — connect, styleElement and removeElement need ids from it; labels attached to a shape are reported on the shape, not as separate elements.

tools.name: addShape
tools.description: Add a rectangle, ellipse or diamond, optionally labelled. x/y/width/height are in scene units; when x and y are omitted the shape is placed to the right of the existing content. Returns the new id.

backgroundColor.description: Hex fill, named Excalidraw color, or transparent.

packagePath.description: Exact document.packagePath from getWhiteboardContext or createWhiteboard. Refuses if the tab changed documents.

tools.name: addText
tools.description: Add a free text label. When x and y are omitted it is placed to the right of the existing content. Returns the new id.

packagePath.description: Exact document.packagePath from getWhiteboardContext or createWhiteboard. Refuses if the tab changed documents.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Draw an arrow bound to two existing elements by id (shapes, text or images — not another arrow), optionally labelled. Bound arrows follow their elements when the user moves them. Place both ends before connecting.

packagePath.description: Exact document.packagePath from getWhiteboardContext or createWhiteboard. Refuses if the tab changed documents.

tools.name: styleElement
tools.description: Restyle one element by id: backgroundColor (hex, Excalidraw color name, or "transparent"), strokeColor, strokeWidth in px, opacity 0-100. At least one of the four is required; position, size and text are the user's to edit on the canvas.

packagePath.description: Exact document.packagePath from getWhiteboardContext or createWhiteboard. Refuses if the tab changed documents.

tools.name: removeElement
tools.description: Delete one element by id, together with its label; arrows attached to it stay but are unbound from it. Only at the user's direction.

packagePath.description: Exact document.packagePath from getWhiteboardContext or createWhiteboard. Refuses if the tab changed documents.

tools.name: clearWhiteboard
tools.description: Erase every element. Refuses while the board holds work unless confirm is true — pass it only when the user asked to start over. The user can undo with ⌘Z in the canvas.

confirm.description: Must be true to erase a board that holds elements.

packagePath.description: Exact document.packagePath from getWhiteboardContext or createWhiteboard. Refuses if the tab changed documents.

tools.name: exportImage
tools.description: Export the whole board as a PNG into the package's assets/exports folder (saving the board first if it has never been saved). Returns the file path. Refuses when the board is empty.

filename.description: Optional file name; ".png" is added when missing. Defaults to the last export name.

packagePath.description: Exact document.packagePath from getWhiteboardContext or createWhiteboard. Refuses if the tab changed documents.
